name: Fabius Analyst · GLM 5.3
description: House analyst agent of Fabius (glm-5.3, reasoning effort low, via qwencloud). Each day it picks ONE locked Fabius bot for the next daily bar; the pick (bot, confidence, sha256 of the full reasoning) is committed to SelectionAnchor before the bar closes and scored later from the public ledger. It never invents trades.
limits_stated_honestly: LLM output is not reproducible; what is verifiable is that the pick existed before the bar closed
